The '''Weikin Rebellion''' is a historical conflict frequently studied by [[White Tower]] [[novice|novices]]. After [[Egwene al'Vere]] was [[Egwene al'Vere/Chronology#Betrayal and capture|forcibly returned to novice status]] she was quizzed about the rebellion by [[Bennae Nalsad]].{{ref/book|c|Weikin Rebellion}}{{ref/book|11|24}} At the time, Egwene knew nothing about it.
